The '''ELG-5C hold-out blaster''' was a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] once hid an ELG-5C in [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] spring loaded ejector, using it during an attack by [[Melter]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].<ref name="Mindor" />
